svg.aria-label: iqforge: random window splitting versus recording-level splitting
svg.desc: Two spectrogram strips of the same SDR recording. In the first, a colour bar assigns individual windows to train, validation and test at random. In the second, every window of a recording carries a single colour, so no recording is divided between splits.
svg.text: — what most pipelines do by default
adjacent windows land in train and test. accuracy goes up, the model doesn't.
every window from one recording stays on one side. classes stay stratified.
when it can't, it errors — it never falls back
